dedupe_keys.name: 土壤液化潛勢圖 earthquakes and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 土壤液化潛勢圖 [earthquakes and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. 本圖資包含全臺8縣市之土壤液化潛勢分布，屬於區域性大範圍的圖資，底圖比例尺為1/25000，可提供國土規劃及防災規劃參考，工程個案的規劃設計則需要更近一步的調查分析，才可判定液化潛勢。 此圖資呈現的土壤液化潛勢，係由各公共工程鑽探及地調所鑽探岩芯及試驗結果，依據建築法規規範方法計算各地之土壤液化潛勢，並將潛勢分為高、中、低三級。 已完成的... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
